sp.1.1.1: Recognise and reproduce with support a range of high frequency target language phonemes.
sp.1.2.1: Understand with support the main idea of simple sentences.

sp.2.3.1: Introduce self and others to an audience using fixed phrases.

sp.3.2.2: Understand specific information and details of simple sentences.
sp.3.2.3: i) Reread a word, phrase or sentence to understand meaning. ii) Ignore unknown words in order to understand a phrase or sentence.

sp.5.3.1: Respond imaginatively and intelligibly through creating simple short chants or raps. Other imaginative responses as appropriate.
